drivers: Simple Latin-square (permutation) rule: each row/column contains the same three bundled figure-types (4 striped, 2 empty, 5 solid), so the missing cell is the one not yet present in row 3
Attributes are bundled (count, shading, shape all co-vary), reducing working-memory load to tracking one composite object
Distractors require checking count, shading and shape (pentagon vs hexagon) simultaneously; careless matchers may pick a 4-count or striped item with wrong shape
75 seconds is ample for a single-rule 3x3 matrix
